exposure: Right ventricle exclusion and Fontan operation
cohort: A single 26-year-old patient with Ebstein's anomaly who had undergone right ventricle exclusion and Fontan operation.
finding: A functional single ventricle patient can successfully complete pregnancy and delivery, especially if valve function, ventricular contractility, Fontan pathway status, and absence of arrhythmia predict a favorable outcome.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed due to symptoms of heart failure.
